name: Blizzard Challenge
ability_definition: The ability to speak clearly so others can understand you.

task_realism.reasoning: Systems produce spoken audio that human listeners must understand, which is the core of speech clarity. However, the task is reading fixed text aloud (TTS), not speaking in workplace settings such as explaining, answering questions, phone calls, or presentations. SUS sentences are deliberately nonsensical, so they isolate acoustic-phonetic intelligibility. They do not reflect how clarity is exercised in meaningful discourse.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Human transcription by paid listeners and native speakers is a strong, direct measure of whether others can understand the speech. Conditions are otherwise idealized: quiet listening, likely on headphones, with no background noise, no telephone or room acoustics, and no interaction or chance for clarification. Only French was tested, and there is no time pressure or real-world stakes. Workplace speech is often heard in degraded, noisy, or distracted conditions.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers segmental intelligibility (WER on SUS) and correct pronunciation of French homographs, which are central slices of clarity. It omits intelligibility under noise, pacing and prosody that aid comprehension, clarity of spontaneous or conversational speech, and adaptation to the listener, such as slowing down or rephrasing. Coverage is also limited to one language and a single edition. Ceiling effects mean fine differences in clarity go unresolved.

format_match.reasoning: The output is real spoken audio, a genuine speech artifact, and the scoring is human transcription, which directly operationalizes being understood. The inputs are artificial, however: semantically unpredictable sentences and targeted homograph items rather than natural workplace utterances or messages.

transferability_reasoning: The Blizzard Challenge 2023 intelligibility test measures clarity directly: human listeners transcribe synthesized speech, and pronunciation is checked on homographs. That makes its construct validity for the core of speech clarity reasonable. Transfer to workplace speech clarity is limited because the setup uses read-aloud TTS, nonsense SUS sentences, quiet listening, French only, and no interaction or adaptation to listeners. The result is a moderate transferability rating, independent of the benchmark's evident saturation.

2020.model_or_system: Blizzard Challenge 2020 MH1 entry 'System L' (anonymised system letter; the team's identity was not verified)
2020.metric: Pinyin-with-Tone Error Rate (PTER), percent (lower is better), from listener transcription of SUS
2020.human_reference: General adult working population of native Mandarin speakers speaking to be understood. The in-test natural-speech reference is a professional voice talent recorded in studio conditions, which is a clearer-than-median speaker.

2021.model_or_system: VRAIN-UPV MLLP TTS system (System J; non-autoregressive acoustic model + HiFi-GAN)
2021.metric: Word error rate (%) from listener transcriptions, Sharvard intelligibility test, task 2021-SH1 (lower is better)
2021.human_reference: General adult speakers reading sentences aloud in a work setting (native European Spanish speakers). The natural-speech reference in Blizzard is a professional voice talent, who is somewhat above the median speaker.

2022.model_or_system: VRAIN-UPV MLLP TTS system (Blizzard Challenge 2021 hub task 2021-SH1)
2022.metric: word error rate (%) from human listener transcriptions, Sharvard intelligibility test; lower is better
2022.human_reference: General adult workforce who speak as part of their jobs, reading prepared Spanish text aloud. The in-test natural-speech reference is a professional voice talent recorded in studio conditions, which likely sits at or somewhat above median worker clarity.

2023.model_or_system: Samsung Speech Synthesis System (Blizzard Challenge 2023 System J; FastSpeech-based acoustic model + HiFi-GAN vocoder)
2023.metric: Mean word error rate (%) from human transcription of semantically unpredictable sentences, Hub task FH1; lower is better
2023.human_reference: General adult native French speakers reading text aloud clearly in quiet conditions. The benchmark's own natural-speech reference is a professional voice talent, who is somewhat clearer than the median adult.
